SELL → STORE → DELIVER
Product story

One handoff instead of three disconnected chores.

MoveMate began with a service-design question: what if letting go of a bulky item felt as simple as ordering one? The working prototype below tests the promise across selling, storage, tracking and buying.

Problem

Reselling furniture asks one person to photograph, list, negotiate, coordinate strangers, store the item and arrange transport. The burden is operational—not only digital.

Opportunity

Temporary storage and resale share the same first step: get the item out of the home. Combining them creates one pickup and lets the owner decide what happens next.

Key decision

I designed around a single accountable service. MoveMate owns pickup, storage, listing updates and delivery instead of leaving logistics to users.

Trade-off

Convenience increases operational cost and trust requirements. The interface therefore makes pickup status, fees, delivery eligibility and next steps unusually visible.

Working solution

The prototype connects item intake, pickup tracking, storage sizing, marketplace browsing, cart and checkout so the service promise can be experienced end to end.

Outcome + next step

The result is a testable product concept rather than static screens. Next, I would validate willingness to pay, storage pricing and the handoff between digital status and real operations.

How MoveMate works

From your space to
their space.

MoveMate combines resale, temporary storage, and local delivery into one simple flow—so useful things keep moving instead of becoming clutter.

01

Tell us what you're ready to let go.

Add a few details, set your expected price, and choose a pickup window that works for you.

02

We pick it up and store it.

No more rearranging your apartment around an item you're trying to sell. We safely hold it while it's listed.

03

We sell it and deliver it.

When the right buyer finds it, MoveMate handles the handoff and delivery. You get paid without coordinating a meetup.

MoveMate temporary storage

Moving soon?
Keep it with us.

Not everything needs to be sold. If you are between apartments, downsizing, traveling, or simply do not have room yet, MoveMate can hold your furniture and household items until you are ready for them again.

You are not forced into a whole storage unit when you only need room for a few pieces.
2

Your items stay with MoveMate while you move, travel, or wait for your new place.
3
Pay by the space you use.
Your monthly estimate changes with the amount of storage you select.

Questions, answered

A smoother way to move things on.

The concept is simple: you hand the item to MoveMate once, and we manage what happens next.

MoveMate is designed for furniture, home décor, small appliances, and other reusable household pieces that are safe to store and transport.

After your item is accepted, you choose an available pickup window. Once we collect it, you no longer have to keep it while waiting for a buyer.

No. MoveMate handles storage, buyer coordination, and delivery, so there is no doorstep meetup to schedule.

Once the transaction is completed, your payout is released according to the final sale price and applicable MoveMate service fees.
